rcmd_type.description: The remote connection module to use (e.g., ssh, rsh, exec).

fanout.description: Maximum number of simultaneous remote commands.

connect_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for establishing a connection.

command_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for remote command execution. 0 means no limit.

remote_user.description: Username to use for remote connections. If empty, uses current user.

ssh_args.description: Arguments passed to the ssh command.

ssh_args_append.description: Additional arguments to append to the ssh command.

targets.description: List of target hosts or hostlist expressions.
